description: Set the output target on a generate node (surface, aspect ratio, size hint, composition/text policy). Run validate_asset_flow afterwards.

compositionRules.description: Composition constraints, e.g. 'negative space top-left for headline'.

copySafety.description: How to leave room for copy, e.g. 'clean negative space'.

sessionId.description: Persisted flow session id (flow_session_…) from create_asset_flow or list_asset_flows.

textPolicy.description: GENERATE_TEXT_POLICY_* — DISALLOW for clean plates with no rendered text.

name: set_generate_target
